text: Seven ancient Chinese ideas that will change how you see effort, pain, and time. Let's snack.
say: Seven ancient Chinese ideas that will change how you see effort, pain, and time. Let's snack.

text: One. Yin and yang. It started as two sides of one hill, sunny and shady. But the sun keeps moving. Some days need you loud, some need you quiet.
say: One. Yin and yang. It started as two sides of one hill, sunny and shady. But the sun keeps moving. Some days need you loud, some need you quiet.

text: Two. Wu wei. Stop forcing. You can't force yourself to sleep. And you can't clear muddy water by stirring it. Leave it still.
say: Two. Woo way. Stop forcing. You can't force yourself to sleep. And you can't clear muddy water by stirring it. Leave it still.

text: Three. Xiu shen. Work on yourself, because everyone around you lives with the result. So, who are you when nobody's watching?
say: Three. Shyoh shen. Work on yourself, because everyone around you lives with the result. So, who are you when nobody's watching?

text: Four. Knowing and doing are one. If you know it but never do it, you don't really know it yet.
say: Four. Knowing and doing are one. If you know it but never do it, you don't really know it yet.

text: Five. The useless tree. The straight trees get cut for wood. The crooked one nobody wants lives on. Keep one thing that doesn't have to be productive.
say: Five. The useless tree. The straight trees get cut for wood. The crooked one nobody wants lives on. Keep one thing that doesn't have to be productive.

text: Six. Store up deeply, release a little. Read a lot, say a little, and your words carry weight.
say: Six. Store up deeply, release a little. Read a lot, say a little, and your words carry weight.

text: Seven. Flowers have their time. A farmer pulled his seedlings to help them grow, and killed them all. Water. Weed. Then wait.
say: Seven. Flowers have their time. A farmer pulled his seedlings to help them grow, and killed them all. Water. Weed. Then wait.

text: Which snack did you need today? Follow Thought Snacks for your daily bite of wisdom.
say: Which snack did you need today? Follow Thought Snacks, for your daily bite of wisdom.
